notes: Numbers from the Jimmy John's Nutrition Guide PDF (effective 07.22.2024). One component unit is one REG portion for an 8" sub, Unwich or sliced wheat; giant (16") builds use the 16" bread with 2 regular portions of each filling (the guide's 16" REG portions are twice the 8" ones). Originals (#1-#6, J.J.B.L.T., #7, #13) are served on the standard scooped 8"/16" French bread; Favorites (#8-#17, Gargantuan) and Slims are on French bread with the bread left in, which is what the published totals reproduce. '<1' in the guide is recorded as 0.5. Unless noted, sandwiches come with lettuce, tomato and mayo; Totally Tuna, Vito and Club Tuna have no mayo; Jimmy Cubano has no lettuce or tomato.

unwich lettuce wrap.derived: guide lists the Unwich lettuce wrap as <1 g carbs; Turkey Tom Unwich minus turkey, lettuce, tomato and mayo, and Slim 4 Unwich minus turkey, both leave 1 g carbs
